synopsis: Nearly a year after the fighting at Hillsbrad, the Burning Legion’s control of the reopened Dark Portal escalates into a wider war. The intervening months have contained further patrols, campaigns, losses, and uneasy service within the Horde—enough history to change habits and deepen battlefield trust, but left deliberately open for later stories. Demons ranging beyond the Blasted Lands now strike settlements and supply routes hard enough that both Horde and Alliance must answer the threat. Falanaras marches with blood elf forces as part of the Horde response alongside Theron, Lethira, and the mixed Horde comrades who first fought beside them at Tarren Mill—Gorath Stonebinder, Jazreth Shadowtide, Mavren Coldwake, and Tahu Windtotem. The Blood Knights stand openly as one of Quel’Thalas’s defining weapons, and the sin’dorei have gained a practical, still-imperfect place within their new faction. At the threshold, Falanaras measures the second crossing against the first: Rynel is dead, M’uru remains chained, Kael’thas has been disowned, old friendships are broken, and Silvermoon’s future is bound to allies who have learned to trust its soldiers more than its methods. Falanaras steps through the Dark Portal carrying those costs into the next war.
title: Epilogue: Beyond the Dark Portal
